metadata.transport: independent processes, localhost DDS, intra-process disabled
metadata.scheduling: single-threaded executor/spin loop; 100 ms wait cap; bounded request window; responses observed in submission order
metadata.rtt_boundary: before async service request through response retrieval, before initiator sum validation
metadata.echo_work: validate every AddTwoInts sequence and operand, then return exact sum
metadata.throughput_boundary: measured completed service requests including validation; excludes discovery/warmup/completion protocol
metadata.completion_protocol: -1 stop request and response, then -2 confirmation; all measured responses complete first

build_manifest.service_callback_api_detection: nodes/service_callbacks.rs contains create_service_native_callback: native request/reused response; absent: owned service stream
build_manifest.benchmark_cfg: --check-cfg=cfg(r2r_bench_service_callbacks); --cfg enables native service callbacks only where their API exists

metadata.qualification: protocol correctness only; busy-host single-repetition evidence; no performance promotion
